decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed development will not have any detrimental effects on parking, traffic or pedestrian safety within the surrounding area and will not result in the loss of any playing fields or recreational areas required for the educational facility. The proposal is therefore compliant with the provisions of Policy C.2.1 (Educational Facilities), Policy T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and policy B.1.1 (New Development) of the Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - That a protective fence shall be erected around the tree located to the west of the proposed position of the garage structure as shown on the siteplan. The fence shall have a minimum diameter of 3 metres.
description: Erection of a garage structure adjacent to the staff carpark
